update_text_de:
Leute, wir brauchen eure besten Momente! 

Unsere Loading Screens sollen nicht einfach irgendwelche Bilder zeigen – sie sollen unseren Server, unsere Spieler und die Geschichten zeigen, die bei uns entstehen.

Und wir wissen alle: Relict ist nicht unbedingt dafür bekannt, euch das Leben auf DeerIsle besonders angenehm zu machen. 

Wenn durch seine schaffende Hand mal wieder irgendetwas völlig eskaliert, ein eigentlich harmloser Ausflug in einer Katastrophe endet oder ihr euch plötzlich fragt, welcher kranke Mensch sich DAS schon wieder ausgedacht hat … dann denkt an eine Sache:

F12! 

Genau diese absurden, schönen, brutalen und manchmal tödlichen Momente suchen wir! Egal ob eine geniale Aussicht, eine verrückte Situation mit anderen Spielern, ein Event, eine Tour mit dem Squad, ein heftiger Kampf, eine Begegnung mit einem Mutanten oder die letzten Sekunden eures Lebens, bevor Relicts neueste Schöpfung euch endgültig ins Jenseits befördert. 

Macht einen Screenshot und postet ihn in unserem Screenshot-Channel! Ich werde mir die Bilder regelmäßig ansehen und daraus Screenshots auswählen, die wir in unsere Loading Screens aufnehmen. Vielleicht ist schon bald euer Screenshot beim nächsten Login zu sehen. 

Wenn es die Situation zulässt, schaltet bitte vor dem Screenshot kurz euer HUD aus. Ohne HUD wirken die Bilder deutlich besser und eignen sich perfekt als Loading Screen.

Wenn euch allerdings gerade drei Mutanten hinterherlaufen, die Welt um euch herum explodiert und Relict irgendwo zufrieden vor seinem Monitor sitzt: HUD vergessen. F12 drücken. Überleben versuchen. 

DeerIsle liefert euch einen absurden Moment? → F12! 📸
Relict versucht euch umzubringen? → F12! 
Ihr habt tatsächlich überlebt? → Erst recht F12! 

Ich freue mich riesig auf eure Bilder – und Relict freut sich vermutlich darauf, für weitere Fotomotive zu sorgen.
update_text_en:
Guys, we need your best moments! 

Our loading screens shouldn’t just show random pictures – they should show our server, our players, and the stories that happen here.

And we all know: Relict isn’t exactly known for making your life on DeerIsle easy. 

When something created by his evil hands turns into complete chaos again, a harmless trip suddenly becomes a disaster, or you find yourself wondering what kind of sick mind came up with THIS … remember one thing:

F12! 

Those are exactly the absurd, beautiful, brutal and sometimes deadly moments we’re looking for! Whether it’s an incredible view, a crazy moment with other players, an event, a trip with your squad, an intense fight, an encounter with a mutant, or the final seconds of your life before Relict’s latest creation sends you straight to the afterlife. 

Take a screenshot and post it in our Screenshot Channel! I’ll regularly go through your submissions and select some of them to become part of our in-game loading screens. Maybe your screenshot will soon be what everyone sees when joining the server. 

If the situation allows it, please turn off your HUD before taking the screenshot. Screenshots without the HUD look much cleaner and are perfect for our loading screens.

But if three mutants are chasing you, the world around you is exploding, and Relict is probably sitting somewhere behind his monitor enjoying the show: Forget the HUD. Hit F12. Try to survive. 

DeerIsle gives you an absurd moment? → F12! 📸
Relict is trying to kill you? → F12! 
You actually survived? → Definitely F12! 

I can’t wait to see your screenshots – and Relict is probably already looking forward to creating a few more photo opportunities.

hints_en: Hint|Don't die!
Hint|You don't have to read these hints, they are useless, as is your attempt to survive.
Hint|If you die, you're dead!
Hint|If you're already dying, try not to die. It usually helps.
Hint|Improving your skills increases your chance of repairing the water pump.
Hint|You can extinguish a fire without water, but it will take much longer.
Hint|The amount of meat you obtain depends directly on your skill level.
Hint|There are many interesting places on the map. Make sure to explore them.
Hint|With a bit of luck, speakers can be repaired using any repair key.
Hint|From meat, vegetables, fruits and mushrooms, you can cook soups and compotes. They have healing properties.
Hint|During heavy rain, you can collect rainwater. It is clean and safe to drink.
Hint|Don't pick unnecessary fights with zombies. You may end up joining your ancestors sooner than expected!
Hint|When butchering an animal or zombie without gloves, there is a chance that you will get a cut.
Hint|Consume berries and vitamins to boost your immunity.
Hint|Walking and overcoming obstacles improves your endurance.
Hint|When killing an animal, you will receive Hunter skill points.
Hint|When shaking the trees, zombies can hear you. Be careful.
Hint|A drug overdose will subside over time or can be treated with a saline infusion.
Hint|You can find stones, sticks, or worms on the ground.
Hint|Hot objects can hurt you. Handle them carefully.
Hint|Support your immune system with vitamins and berries. The chances of getting sick will be lower.
Hint|Taking medication too frequently can cause an overdose.
Hint|Upgrade your skills to gain an advantage in the game.
Hint|You can find special protective cases with useful loot.
Hint|Infected are much stronger and more aggressive at night.
Hint|Fishing is a great way to avoid starving.
Hint|When bitten, wild animals can infect you with rabies.
Hint|Some batteries can be recharged for reuse.
Hint|Use the tester to find out what illness you have.
Hint|Be careful with hot food. Let it cool down before eating it.
Hint|Don't get too close to windows! The infected may be stupid, but they can still hit you.
Hint|Find and read books. This way you will improve your skills.
Hint|The skill menu opens by default with the [O] key. You can change it in the settings.
Hint|Items can fall out of damaged equipment. Keep an eye on its condition.
Hint|Syringes must be sterilized before an injection.
Hint|When you die, you will lose all the skills you have learned and the experience you have gained. Death is just the beginning...
Hint|You can dismantle weapons and attachments you no longer need.
Hint|If you eat the same food, you will get an intolerance. You should diversify your diet.
Hint|Tablets outside their blister packs deteriorate when wet. Store them somewhere dry and protected.
Hint|When you die, all your experience and skills are reset to zero. Be careful!
Hint|Digging in the reeds, you can find small animals such as frogs.
Hint|At night, STRENGTH skills improve twice as efficiently.
Hint|Sometimes you will find closed boxes with useful loot inside. You can open them using various tools.
Hint|Choose your tool carefully when opening locked containers. Your choice can affect the condition of the loot inside.
Hint|You can disassemble the gas mask filter with a screwdriver and pliers.
Hint|Madness develops when you kill players, zombies, as well as when cutting up zombies and being near them.
Hint|The condition of your food directly affects how many calories you receive from it.
Hint|You can open a tin can with your bare hands, but you will lose most of its contents.
Hint|When eating dirty fruits, vegetables and mushrooms, you can catch salmonella.
Hint|Fruit, vegetables, and mushrooms can be washed at a working water pump, with clean water, or in the rain.
Hint|A medication overdose will subside over time or can be treated with activated charcoal.

Hint|There are many interesting places on the map. Make sure to explore them.
Hint|With a bit of luck, speakers can be repaired using any repair key.
Hint|From meat, vegetables, fruits and mushrooms, you can cook soups and compotes. They have healing properties.
Hint|During heavy rain, you can collect rainwater. It is clean and safe to drink.
Hint|Don't pick unnecessary fights with zombies. You may end up joining your ancestors sooner than expected!
Hint|If you meet a survivor named Shinobe, be sure to ask him: “Where is the saw?”
Hint|When butchering an animal or zombie without gloves, there is a chance that you will get a cut.
Hint|Consume berries and vitamins to boost your immunity.
Hint|Walking and overcoming obstacles improves your endurance.
Hint|When killing an animal, you will receive Hunter skill points.
Hint|When shaking the trees, zombies can hear you. Be careful.
Hint|A drug overdose will subside over time or can be treated with a saline infusion.
Hint|Digging in the ground can uncover various items that may help you survive.
Hint|Hot objects can hurt you. Handle them carefully.
Hint|There are many ways to obtain water – try one of them.
Hint|Concussions and overdoses subside over time – assuming you don't die first.
Hint|Watch your step at military facilities – otherwise you may soon have nothing left to watch with.
Hint|Sometimes it's better to slow down and crouch – it can save your life.
Hint|That rabbit may be more than you can handle – find easier prey.
Hint|Before searching the reeds in the swamps, look around carefully – it may save you some trouble.
Hint|This is RELIFE – one dirty apple can cost you your life.
Hint|Remember: jumping over fences can leave you with torn or even bloodstained pants.
Hint|Padre is not in the position to cut nails – leave this occupation for peaceful times.
Hint|Don't break bushes with your bare hands. Without a bandage, a simple cut can become a serious problem.
Hint|After three months of playing on the server, feel free to add [Stress Resistance] to your resume – you deserve it.
Hint|Support your immune system with vitamins and berries. The chances of getting sick will be lower.
Hint|If you use medications frequently, you may get an overdose.
Hint|Take care of your health and don't let illnesses go untreated – sometimes one pill isn't enough.
Hint|Upgrade your skills to gain an advantage in the game.
Hint|Brewed chamomile tea is particularly effective against madness, but keep an eye on your fatigue after drinking it.
Hint|Before you go fishing, think about it! Do you really need it, or is it better to spend time on something more important?
Hint|You can find special protective cases with useful loot.
Hint|Infected are much stronger and more aggressive at night.
Hint|Fishing is a great way to avoid starving.
Hint|When bitten, wild animals can infect you with rabies.
Hint|If you're trapped in a locked house with no way to open the door, don't despair – shout from a window. Someone may come to help.
Hint|Some batteries can be recharged for reuse.
Hint|Use the tester to find out what illness you have.
Hint|Be careful with hot food. Let it cool down before eating it.
Hint|Don't get too close to windows! The infected may not be smart, but they can still hit you.
Hint|Do not handle objects hotter than 75 °C unless you have the appropriate perk.
Hint|Find and read books. This way you will improve your skills.
Hint|The skill menu opens by default with the [O] key. You can change it in the settings.
Hint|If you are already dying, then do not die to continue playing.
Hint|Food spoils over time. Eat or prepare it before it causes problems.
Hint|Your belongings can fall out of damaged equipment. Keep an eye on its condition.
Hint|Syringes must be sterilized before an injection.
Hint|When you die, you will lose all the skills you have learned and the experience you have gained. Death is just the beginning...
Hint|You can dismantle weapons and attachments you no longer need.
Hint|If you eat the same food, you will get an intolerance. You should diversify your diet.
Hint|Wet tablets outside the blister deteriorate over time. Keep them in moisture-proof places.
Hint|When you die, all your experience and skills are reset to zero. Be careful!
Hint|Digging in the reeds, you can find small animals such as frogs.
Hint|Wet clothes increase your risk of catching a cold. Dry off instead of staying soaked.
Hint|At night, passive leveling of Strength skills is twice as effective.
Hint|Sometimes you will find closed boxes with useful loot inside. You can open them using various tools.
Hint|Choose your tool carefully when opening locked containers. Your choice can affect the condition of the loot inside.
Hint|You can disassemble the gas mask filter with a screwdriver and pliers.
Hint|Madness can develop when you kill players or zombies, butcher zombies, or spend too much time near them.
Hint|The condition of your food directly affects how many calories you receive from it.
Hint|You can open a tin can with your bare hands, but you will lose most of its contents.
Hint|When eating dirty fruits, vegetables and mushrooms, you can catch salmonella.
Hint|Fruit, vegetables, and mushrooms can be washed at a working water pump, with clean water, or in the rain.
Hint|A medication overdose will subside over time or can be treated with activated charcoal.
Hint|Don't die!

Rule|Raiding locked bases is prohibited. Bases made only from frames without boards are not considered locked. Make sure your shelter is fully built!
Rule|Aggression and provocation intended to get other players killed are prohibited!
Rule|Intentional damage to other people's property is prohibited.
Rule|Killing other players is strictly prohibited, regardless of who they are.
Rule|Do not settle personal disputes in public chat.
Rule|Barter and transactions between players are not prohibited. The administration is not responsible for their outcome.
Rule|A person, clan, or player group may own only one base.
Rule|It is forbidden to build door to door, wall to wall
Rule|It is forbidden to scatter unclaimed loot in the safe zone. To do this, there are sheds where you can put the loot you don't need.
Rule|It is forbidden to build on the spawn sites of players.
Rule|Provocations of any kind are prohibited.
Rule|Insulting other players and the server administration is prohibited.
Rule|It is forbidden to incite ethnic strife. Discrimination and humiliation of other players is prohibited.
Rule|Flooding and spam of any kind are prohibited.
Rule|It is forbidden to build a base without entrances and exits.
Rule|Do not block building entrances with tents, beds, or similar objects.
Rule|Relogging is prohibited – deliberately leaving the game to avoid combat or secure loot.
Rule|Looking through building or shelter textures is prohibited (Big Brother is watching you).
Rule|Loot rule: whoever picks up the loot first owns it – for example at a helicopter crash, train, or other loot event.
Rule|Any harmful action against players or their property is prohibited in survivor camps.
Rule|Shooting or throwing smoke grenades, flares, or glow sticks inside survivor camps is prohibited.
Rule|Any physical harm to other players is prohibited. Be careful with your new friends!
